 How to watch Katie Boulter v Katerina Siniakova at the Japan Open: TV channel, live streaming, start time and venue
 bet365 News Team
 Published: 15 hours ago
 Britain's Katie Boulter will be aiming to continue her impressive week in Osaka when she plays Katerina Siniakova in the semi-finals of the Japan Open on Saturday. 
 After starting the tournament with comfortable back-to-back straight set successes, the 30-year-old was forced to dig deep and come from a set down to beat Antonia Ruzic and book a place in the last four - a result which also sees her reclaim her spot as the British number one.

 Katie Boulter v Katerina Siniakova start time, venue & date
 Katie Boulter v Katerina Siniakova is the second match to be played at the Utsubo Tennis Center and is expected to start at approximately 05:30 BST on Saturday 24th October.
